第26章 巅峰离场，一亿八千万现金落袋-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

“抛。”

指令下达的瞬间。

整个会议室像被点燃的火药桶，瞬间炸开。

周明远双手猛地砸向键盘，十指化作残影，交易软件的界面被迅速调出。

叶知秋一把抓起桌上的专线电话，连通交易室，声音冷硬得没有一丝起伏：“全仓清退，准备接单！”

韩松死死盯着屏幕上开始剧烈波动的数字，连呼吸都忘了。

一亿八千万的筹码，像一座冰山，狠狠砸向了脆弱的盘面。

“先走两千手，探探底下的承接力！”林川没有坐在老板椅上，他直接站了起来，双手撑在会议桌边缘，身体前倾，目光像死盯猎物的狼一样咬住投影幕布。

他不是神仙。

接近两个亿的盘子要在高位撤出来，稍有不慎就是踩踏事故。他现在的神经绷得比谁都紧。

“五千手砸出去了！”周明远大吼一声，额头上已经渗出了一层细密的汗珠。

屏幕上，红色的分时线猛地往下坠了一格。

买一位置的五万手封单，瞬间被吃掉了十分之一。

但紧接着，诡异的一幕出现了。

原本挂在买二买三位置的几万手大单，像见了鬼一样，突然凭空消失！

“主力撤单了！”周明远声音都劈叉了，猛地抬头看向林川，“他们在下面根本没打算接！上面的封单是假的！”

诱多。

庄家在虚晃一枪，只要有人敢大笔砸盘，他们立刻撤掉底下的托盘，让散户去接刀子。

会议室里的空气瞬间凝固。

韩松的后背瞬间被冷汗湿透。

完了。

这么大的资金量，底下根本没有足够的买盘承接。只要再往下砸，股价立刻就会雪崩，涨停板会被瞬间砸穿，利润会被疯狂吞噬！

“林总……”周明远的手指悬在键盘上方，微微发抖，不敢再敲下去。

“别停！”林川猛地直起身子，眼神凶狠得吓人，“看承接，往下压！买一撤了就砸买二！买二没了就砸买三！”

“可是滑点损耗太大了！一档一档往下砸，起码要少赚……”

“老子让你砸！”

林川一声暴喝，直接打断了周明远的话，声音在会议室里炸响。

“不要恋战！先出来！庄家想跑，老子偏要跑在他们前面！给老子不计成本往下倒！”

他的情绪彻底爆发。

这才是真正的资本绞肉机。

什么云淡风轻，什么波澜不惊，在几千万的利润波动面前全是扯淡。要赢，就得比庄家更狠、更决绝！

周明远咬紧牙关，双眼通红，键盘被敲得震天响。

“第二笔六千手，市价往下压一毛砸出！”

“第三笔三千手，继续砸！”

屏幕上的分时线开始像心电图一样剧烈跳水。

涨停板被硬生生砸开！

126.3元。

125.8元。

124.5元。

每一次数字跳动，都是几十上百万的资金在蒸发。

韩松死死咬住嘴唇，眼睁睁看着总资产那一栏的数字从1.89亿往下掉，心跳快得几乎要撞破胸膛。

太狠了。

别人炒股是想卖在最高点，林川这是在拿利润换时间，直接把筹码当废纸一样往外泼！

两点五十八分。

距离收盘还有最后两分钟。

“还有多少没出？”林川死盯着屏幕，声音带点沙哑。

“还有最后两千万的市值！”周明远嗓子都快喊哑了，“底下散户的承接力快耗尽了，再砸可能要触及跌停！”

林川眼睛眯成了一条缝。

盘面上，庄家的资金也反应过来了，几笔大单开始疯狂出逃，试图跟林川抢跑道。

“挂市价。”林川深吸了一口气，眼神里透出一股狠戾，“全倒给他们。”

“全倒？！”周明远倒吸一口凉气。

“给我清零！”

回车键被重重敲下。

最后两千万的筹码，像一颗重磅炸弹，直接砸进了深不见底的盘口。

"Throw."

The moment the order is given.

The entire conference room exploded instantly like a ignited powder keg.

Zhou Mingyuan slammed his hands on the keyboard, his fingers turned into afterimages, and the interface of the trading software was quickly called up.

Ye Zhiqiu grabbed the dedicated phone on the table and connected it to the trading room. His voice was so cold that there was no fluctuation at all: "Exit all positions and prepare to take orders!"

Han Song stared at the numbers on the screen that began to fluctuate violently, and even forgot to breathe.

180 million chips, like an iceberg, hit the fragile market hard.

"Take two thousand hands first to test the capacity underneath!" Lin Chuan did not sit on the boss's chair. He stood up directly, placed his hands on the edge of the conference table, leaned forward, and bit the projection screen with his eyes like a wolf staring at its prey.

He is not a god.

A plate worth close to 200 million has to be withdrawn at a high level. If you are not careful, there will be a stampede accident.His nerves are tighter than anyone else's right now.

"Five thousand hands smashed it out!" Zhou Mingyuan roared, with a layer of fine sweat beads on his forehead.

On the screen, the red time-sharing line suddenly dropped one space.

A tenth of the 50,000-lot closing order bought in one position was eaten up in an instant.

But then, a strange scene occurred.

The tens of thousands of large orders that were originally placed at the buy-two-buy-three position suddenly disappeared out of thin air as if they had seen a ghost!

"The main force has withdrawn the order!" Zhou Mingyuan's voice was split, and he suddenly looked up at Lin Chuan, "They have no intention of accepting it at all! The order above is fake!"

Lure more.

The dealers are feinting. As long as someone dares to hit the market with a large sum of money, they will immediately remove the tray underneath and let retail investors pick up the knives.

The air in the conference room solidified instantly.

Han Song's back was instantly soaked with cold sweat.

It's over.

With such a large amount of funds, there are simply not enough buying orders.As long as it drops further, the stock price will immediately collapse, the daily limit will be smashed through in an instant, and the profits will be eaten up crazily!

"Mr. Lin..." Zhou Mingyuan's fingers hung above the keyboard, trembling slightly, and he did not dare to type any more.

"Don't stop!" Lin Chuan straightened up suddenly, his eyes were frighteningly fierce, "Look at the takeover, press down! If you buy one and withdraw it, buy two! If you buy two and run out, buy three!"

"But the slippage loss is too great! If you drop one gear after another, at least you will make less money..."

"I want you to smash it!"

Lin Chuan shouted loudly, directly interrupting Zhou Mingyuan's words, and his voice exploded in the conference room.

"Don't be obsessed with fighting! Come out first! The dealer wants to run away, but I want to run ahead of them! I'll fall down regardless of the cost!"

His emotions completely exploded.

This is the real meat grinder of capital.

What is calm and calm is all nonsense in the face of tens of millions of profit fluctuations.To win, you have to be more ruthless and decisive than the dealer!

Zhou Mingyuan gritted his teeth, his eyes turned red, and the keyboard was knocked loudly.

"The second lot of 6,000 lots will be sold at a dime if the market price drops!"

"The third stroke is three thousand, keep smashing!"

The time-sharing line on the screen began to dive violently like an electrocardiogram.

The daily limit was suddenly smashed open!

126.3 yuan.

125.8 yuan.

124.5 yuan.

Every time the numbers jump, tens or millions of dollars are evaporating.

Han Song bit his lip and watched helplessly as the number in the total assets column dropped from 189 million, his heart beating so fast that it almost broke his chest.

Too cruel.

Others speculate in stocks because they want to sell at the highest point, but Lin Chuan is exchanging profits for time, throwing away the chips like waste paper!

Two fifty-eight.

There are only two minutes left until the closing bell.

"How many more are there?" Lin Chuan stared at the screen, his voice a little hoarse.

"There is still a market value of the last 20 million!" Zhou Mingyuan shouted, his voice almost hoarse, "The retail investors' capacity is almost exhausted, and if we continue to hit it, it may hit the bottom limit!"

Lin Chuan's eyes narrowed into slits.

On the market, the banker's funds also reacted, and several large orders began to flee frantically, trying to compete with Lin Chuan.

"Market price." Lin Chuan took a deep breath, with a cruel look in his eyes, "Give it all to them."

"All down?!" Zhou Mingyuan took a breath of cold air.

"Clear it for me!"

The Enter key was hit hard.

The last 20 million chips were like a bomb, directly hitting the bottomless handicap.
